g.title: GHD_QSP
g.text: Paediatric Growth Hormone Deficiency (GHD) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Hypothalamic GHRH/SST oscillator → somatotroph → GH → GHR/JAK2/STAT5b → hepatic IGF-1 (ternary complex) → growth-plate chondrocyte engine → height velocity
Drug layer: daily somatropin · weekly long-acting GH (lonapegsomatropin / somatrogon / somapacitan) · mecasermin (rhIGF-1) · GnRH analogue · aromatase inhibitor · diagnostic secretagogues
